versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The PNC bit vector filter algorithm shall compare (bit- wise AND) the received PNC bit vector with the PN filter mask to detect if a relevant PNC is requested or not. Each PNC bit of the PN filter mask shall have the following meaning: • 0: The PNC request is irrelevant for the ECU. The communication stack of the ECU is not kept awake if this bit is set in a received PNC bit vector. • 1: The PNC request is relevant for the ECU. The communication stack of the ECU is kept awake if this bit is set in a received PNC bit vector.
